seoTitle: Density Converter: kg/m3, g/cm3, lb/ft3 with Materials
metaDescription: Convert kg/m3, g/cm3, g/mL, lb/ft3 and lb per gallon, and see typical material densities. Free tool.
intro: Converts density between kilograms per cubic metre, grams per cubic centimetre, pounds per cubic foot or inch, pounds per gallon and ounces per cubic inch, with common material densities.
why:
Density is quoted as kg/m3 in engineering, g/cm3 in labs and lb/ft3 in US trades. Converting wrongly by a factor of 1000 is easy.

The list of typical materials gives a sanity check. Those values are textbook approximations, not data for a specific alloy or wood.
howTo: Read the converted values and compare with the material list.

faq.q: Is g/cm3 the same as g/mL?
faq.a: Yes. 1 g/cm3 equals 1 g/mL, 1 kg/L and 1000 kg/m3.

faq.q: What is the density of water?
faq.a: About 1000 kg/m3 at 4 C, slightly less when warmer.
